Ivy (Docs): Quick sync: opened a tiny PR to harmonize streaming + pagination + retry snippets across py/ts/go. Goal: remove legacy `cursor` usage, show page_token for pagination, and recommend async iterators for streams. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024

Sam (SDK): I can update TS + Go. Do we want an explicit note about default retry behavior?

Ivy (Docs): Yes — single-line: client.config.retry defaults to 3 attempts with exponential backoff. Link to /docs/reference/client-config. Also add a short migration note under Guides -> Pagination: "If you used `cursor`, migrate to server-issued `page_token` or streaming iterators."

Rae (DevEx): For Python include sync + async patterns. Async pattern suggestion:
```py
async with client.responses.stream(model="rwd-large", input="Summarize") as stream:
    async for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.output_text, end="")
```
Keep method names stable so examples don't break existing users.

Harper (ENG-ML): Add runtime caveat: streaming + KV-cache not supported on heavily quantized tiny variants (e.g., rwd-tiny-q). Also note that retries can change chunk boundaries; callers should be tolerant.

link-bot: link-checker: broken anchor found in /docs/guides/pagination -> `#cursor-sample`. Please fix before merge.

Ivy (Docs): I'll patch the anchor and update the style guide about stable anchors. Sam, please remove any `cursor: null` from your samples and re-run link-check locally. Rae, can you add a tiny regression snippet to the snippets test harness to validate streaming yields `output_text` keys?

Sam (SDK): Will do. Branch: docs/snippets/stream-sync-1024. I'll push TS+Go changes tonight and include the client-config link. Assigning reviewers @Rae @Harper.

Rae (DevEx): Adding tiny snippets-ci test that runs the JS example in a sandbox and asserts each yielded chunk has `output_text`. Also add a pagination test that checks `nextPageToken` semantics.

Ivy (Docs): Perfect. Once CI green I'll merge. Ping me if anything blocks. Thanks :thumbsup:
